transcription.text: I'm here with Asfand from Aurora 3D. Tell us about what you guys do.

Right. How does the smartphone work?
Well, the big thing about the smartphone is that you have a camera on it, a really high
quality camera, and today's smartphones are really, really powerful. So, what it does
is basically as it scans across the object, the laser scans across the object, it uses
the smartphone to essentially rebuild that object in 3D. So, it analyses that line as
it scans across the object.
Why a smartphone and not just a regular PC?

reducing cost. So, what happens with a 3D scanner is you need three things. You need
a camera, you need a lot of processing power and you need a laser, basically. And two of
the three are in a smartphone and pretty much everyone's got a smartphone.
So, why not?
By bringing your own smartphone, you essentially reduce the cost.
